faq.q: Do I have to donate to get releases?
faq.a: No. New episodes still reach the Telegram channel for everyone. Donations pay for servers, storage and encoding time, and the perks are a thank-you.

faq.q: How do I get my role?
faq.a: After you pay, post a screenshot of the payment in the donation channel on Discord. I check it and add your role by hand, then your name, amount and comment show up on this page.
Yes. Perks unlock at the amounts above and follow your total, so small donations add up. Every amount counts toward the monthly goal and the donor wall.

faq.q: What is the cultivation realm bar?
faq.a: It tracks this month's goal. Every dollar raised moves the channel up a realm, from Mortal to Ascension. Reaching Ascension means this month's server and storage costs are covered.
Donations are voluntary and pay for servers, storage and bandwidth. They are not a purchase of content.
